name: display-switcher
title: Display Switcher
description: Hand shared monitors to the other Mac, one or all at once, over DDC/CI with m1ddc.
author: sujha

commands.name: toggle-displays
commands.title: Toggle Displays
commands.subtitle: Both
commands.description: Switch every configured monitor to the Mac it isn't showing (no UI).

commands.name: toggle-primary-display
commands.title: Toggle Primary Display
commands.subtitle: First in Monitor Inputs
commands.description: Switch only the first monitor in Monitor Inputs to the Mac it isn't showing (no UI).

commands.name: toggle-secondary-display
commands.title: Toggle Secondary Display
commands.subtitle: Second in Monitor Inputs
commands.description: Switch only the second monitor in Monitor Inputs to the Mac it isn't showing (no UI).

commands.name: reset-displays
commands.title: Reset Displays
commands.subtitle: Follow Primary
commands.description: Send every monitor to the Mac the primary monitor shows, to undo a mixed-up state (no UI).

preferences.name: inputs
preferences.title: Monitor Inputs
preferences.description: One entry per monitor, separated by ';'. Each entry: 'name=A/B', where name matches the monitor's name (from `m1ddc display list`) and A/B are the input codes of the two Macs. The same value works on both Macs. Common codes: DP 1: 15, DP 2: 16, HDMI 1: 17, HDMI 2: 18, USB-C: 27. Some Samsungs use HDMI 1: 5, HDMI 2: 6.

preferences.name: m1ddcPath
preferences.title: m1ddc Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to the m1ddc executable. Leave empty for auto-detection.

preferences.name: otherMac
preferences.title: Other Mac (SSH)
preferences.description: Optional SSH destination of the other Mac, e.g. 'sujha@Subhashs-MacBook-Pro-2.local'. Before a monitor is switched to it, its display is woken over SSH (caffeinate -u), so a monitor's built-in KVM hands it the keyboard even when its lid is closed and its display asleep. Needs Remote Login on that Mac and key-based login from this one (no prompt).
